parsed.rationale: Three distinct production types — `HSBColor` in package `ColorPalette` and `AccentColor` and `HSBOffset` in package `Wallpaper` — each independently define an identical `init(hue:saturation:brightness:)` initializer, as flagged by the `function-duplicates-exact` query. None of the records carry any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false). The shared initializer signature strongly suggests a common HSB-component construction contract that can be expressed as a protocol `HSBInitializable` with a default implementation provided in a protocol extension, eliminating the three redundant bodies. The `ColorPalette` package is the natural home for this protocol since `HSBColor` already lives there and `Wallpaper` already depends on color-domain concepts; alternatively the protocol could live in a thin shared `ColorPalette` module that both packages import.
